productionDecision: Patch 26B resolved the Capital Mapbox preload issue. capital.html no longer references vendor-mapbox JS, vendor-mapbox CSS, vendor-maplibre, or modulepreload vendor-mapbox. The remaining large map chunks are documented route-heavy assets and should be verified through browser route signoff.

findings.interpretation: Capital HTML still references Mapbox CSS, meaning CSS preload behavior remains even after Mapbox JS was filtered.
Capital HTML still references Mapbox JS. Patch 24 should have removed this if the modulePreload filter worked.
Capital still preloads pages-exchange. If pages-exchange CSS/JS carries Mapbox CSS, Mapbox CSS may continue to preload.
A static import of mapbox-gl CSS can force Vite to include Mapbox CSS in upstream CSS dependency graphs.
Static Mapbox JS import is acceptable only if isolated inside an async map component that is not preloaded.
Capital generated JS still contains Vite dependency metadata, which may be responsible for preload behavior.

likelyCause: Patch 24 removed Mapbox JS from capital.html, but Mapbox CSS remains. The next patch should target the static Mapbox CSS import path.
A source file still statically imports mapbox-gl/dist/mapbox-gl.css. That CSS should likely move behind the same async boundary as the Mapbox component.
capital.html still preloads pages-exchange, so any CSS dependency attached to pages-exchange can still be pulled early.

interpretation: Patch 24 removed Mapbox JS preload from capital.html.
Patch 25 proved the remaining issue was a static Mapbox CSS import in SHSOperationalMapboxMap.jsx.
Patch 26B removed the static CSS import from the active component and moved CSS loading behind the runtime map component boundary.
capital.html now still preloads pages-exchange, but it no longer preloads vendor-mapbox JS or CSS directly.
The remaining vendor-mapbox and vendor-maplibre bundle-size warnings are acceptable only if browser route signoff confirms they load on map-needed routes, not on ordinary Capital entry load.
